changeSet.author: antigravity
changeSet.comment: Create materialized view for dashboard aggregations with concurrent refresh support.
changeSet.sql:
CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW mv_daily_recon_summary AS SELECT t.trade_date, c.region, t.asset_class, COUNT(*) AS total_trades, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.status = 'MATCHED') AS matched_trades, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.status IN ('UNMATCHED','DISPUTED')) AS break_trades, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(t.quantity * t.price)::NUMERIC, 2), 0) AS gross_notional, ROUND( (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE t.status = 'MATCHED')::NUMERIC / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)) * 100, 2 ) AS match_rate_pct FROM trades t JOIN counterparties c ON t.counterparty_id = c.id WHERE t.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY t.trade_date, c.region, t.asset_class;
-- Unique index required for REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW CONCURRENTLY CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_mv_daily_recon_summary ON mv_daily_recon_summary (trade_date, region, asset_class);

rollback.sql: DROP MATERIALIZED VIEW IF EXISTS mv_daily_recon_summary;
